errors.text_span: while all other language bars are close to 1
errors.evidence: The chart shows only a single bar for 'English' in the year 2012. There are no bars for any other languages in that year, contrary to the description's claim.

errors.text_span: In 2022, the English dataset bar is significantly taller, reaching a value of approximately 90, and, along with “All other,” are the tallest bars of that year.
errors.evidence: The description misreads the chart for the year 2022. The English bar in 2022 has a value of approximately 15, not 90. The value of ~90 corresponds to the English bar in 2021. Additionally, in 2022, the 'All other' bar is the tallest (at ~20), not the English bar.

errors.text_span: The chart does not appear to utilize any visual emphasis such as shading or outlining; the bars are uniformly colored within their respective language categories.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there is no visual emphasis. The bars for the year 2022 are clearly rendered in a lighter, faded shade compared to the bars for all other years, which constitutes a form of visual emphasis.
